newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends little changed on dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends little changed on dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed broadly flat at 494.50/495.50 per dollar Friday as the Central Bank covered currency demand, traders said.
The bolivar closed at 494.30/495.00 per dollar Thursday.
"There was some demand from corporate clients and across the counter, but the Central Bank was very attentive and did not allow the rate to rise more than 0.50 bolivars per dollar," one trader said.

Some traders felt that the exchange rate, which has been broadly stable in thin trade for much of the week, could creep upwards next week due to large expiries of Central Bank papers flooding the market with excess liquidity.
